newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden Riksbank says no plans to revalue gold.
newsitem.headline: Sweden Riksbank says no plans to revalue gold.

text.p: Sweden's central bank said on Friday it had no plans to revalue or sell any gold reserves at the moment.

"We haven't made any decision to revalue the gold reserves," Mats Balke, financial controller at the Riksbank, told Reuters. "It's not on the agenda now but nothing really stops us from doing so. It is purely an accounting issue."
He added the Riksbank did not have any plans to sell gold either.
The Riksbank's gold reserves amount to 185.4 tonnes and have been booked at 1.15 billion crowns since the beginning of the year, he said.
The rate has been fixed at 6,190.08 crowns a kilo for a couple of decades, Balke said.
